title: Carolina Collection Guest Towel Stand (16.3-Inch) - Solid Brass Countertop Vanity Hand Towel Stand | Mediterranean Blue | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep guest towels within reach of the sink while keeping the vanity tidy in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. The Carolina Collection guest towel stand adds stable, countertop towel storage with a traditional, classic look.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Protects surfaces: felt pad on the bottom helps prevent scratching on countertops
  • Easy to coordinate: ideal for matching Carolina with other traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories
  • Built from brass: crafted from solid brass materials

Specs
Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 16.3 x 14 x 5.5 in.
Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 8 x 8 in.
Shipping weight: 7 lbs.
multiple designer finish options available
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
